whatsappMessage:
Hi Team ICONIK7,

I noticed your gym has stellar 4.9★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership and 24-hour trial inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, 24/7 batch timings, aur workout programs integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://iconik7.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi ICONIK7 Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with 24/7 access details and direct WhatsApp trial booking for Kankarbagh fitness seekers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
